language.label: Language
language.help: Choose a language. Some pages still use English.

signal.title: RF / Signal
signal.subtitle: The signal behind reported receptions.
signal.error: Could not load signal data. Try refreshing or choosing a shorter time period.
signal.measurement: Signal measured by observers on the last hop. Charts count retained receptions and use UTC time.
signal.window: Window: {{since}} to {{until}} UTC (end exclusive). Complete-hour snapshots refresh in the background; the current hour is excluded. Blank hours do not establish an outage.
signal.empty: No retained receptions in this window.
signal.averagesHelp: Each mean weights every available reception equally. Missing includes absent, invalid and zero/zero unavailable readings; a measured zero SNR remains valid. SNR and RSSI can have different sample counts. These readings do not measure end-to-end quality or packet loss, and colors are not quality thresholds.
signal.binsHelp: Bins include the lower bound and exclude the upper bound. The outer bins include all values beyond the display range. Hourly means below are rounded to one decimal place.
signal.histogramDescription: {{metric}} distribution in {{unit}}. Exact bin boundaries and counts follow below.
signal.trendDescription: Hourly mean {{metric}} in {{unit}}, UTC. Missing readings remain gaps. Exact values are in the hourly table.
signal.coverageDescription: Available and unavailable readings for SNR and RSSI. Exact counts and percentages are in the sample availability table.

paths.subtitle: How received packets carry route hashes.
paths.error: Could not load path data. Try refreshing or choosing a shorter time period.
paths.measurement: Path entries reported by observers, counted per reception. Hash-width shares use nonempty hash paths.
paths.window: Window: {{since}} to {{until}} UTC (end exclusive). Complete-hour snapshots refresh in the background; the current hour is excluded. Blank hours lack retained records.
paths.empty: No retained receptions in this window.
paths.countsHelp: Flood paths accumulate entries; direct routes contain remaining entries. Empty paths have no hash-width vote. Trace headers carry signal readings. Unclassified records lack usable payload or path metadata.
paths.details: Exact width, path-length and hourly values
paths.lengthsHelp: Length counts include validated ordinary empty paths at zero. In the trend, recorded hours with no hash paths show zero; absent hours remain gaps.
paths.widthDescription: Hash-width share among nonempty ordinary paths. Empty, trace and unclassified records are excluded. Exact counts follow below.
paths.coverageDescription: Path classification for all retained receptions. The four categories partition the total; exact counts follow alongside.
paths.lengthDescription: Received path entries per reception. Zero means an empty ordinary path. Trace and unclassified records are excluded. Exact counts follow in the table.
paths.trendDescription: Hourly receptions carrying nonempty 1, 2 or 3-byte hash paths, UTC. Absent hours remain gaps. Exact values follow in the hourly table.

traffic.subtitle: When and where observers report receptions.
traffic.error: Could not load traffic. Try refreshing.
traffic.measurement: Counts are reported receptions, not unique packets. Blank hours have no retained hourly record; they do not establish an outage. Times are UTC and the latest hour may be partial.
traffic.empty: No retained receptions in this window.
traffic.groupingHelp: Charts group smaller areas into “Other IATAs”; this table keeps every area.
traffic.shareDescription: Reception share by IATA. Exact counts and percentages follow in the table.
traffic.trendDescription: Hourly reported receptions by IATA. Gaps mean no retained hourly record. Exact totals follow in the data table.
traffic.heatmapDescription: Activity heatmap by UTC day and hour. Brighter cells indicate more reported receptions; blank cells have no retained record.
